news.title: Kuniko strikes again as NSW gold-silver system grows
news.snippet: Kuniko has struck gold-silver mineralisation in all 11 drill holes across two campaigns at its NSW Commonwealth-Silica Hill project ahead of a December resource update.

news.title: ClearVue wins A$700,000 US Govt grant for solar glass tech
news.snippet: ClearVue and US partner Silfab Solar have won a US$500,000 grant from the US Dept of Energy to develop high-efficiency solar spandrel technology for the US market.

news.title: Aftermarket raid: Embattled data centre company NextDC’s shares soar
news.snippet: Major delays to NextDC’s flagship Melbourne facility left it vulnerable to an “opportunistic” raid by two rivals seeking to buy up to 10 per cent of the company.

news.title: Aureka lands production licence for historic Vic gold mine
news.snippet: Aureka Ltd has landed a production licence for its Comstock gold project in Victoria, paving the way for a mining restart and a second ore source for its Wedderburn mill.

news.title: ‘Came in to say goodbye’: Shelves stripped bare as luxury brands desert David Jones
news.snippet: David Jones’ owners have appointed administrators, which is expected to trigger an extensive restructure of the company and thousands of job losses.

news.title: The billionaire who’s a winner from David Jones’ collapse
news.snippet: The collapse of David Jones is expected to give its rival Myer a boost, as reflected in the surging Myer share price.

news.title: Right Resources puts 3km NSW tungsten trend in spotlight
news.snippet: Right Resources has uncovered multiple tungsten targets at its Moonlight prospect in NSW, with rock chips returning high grades of up to 0.61 per cent tungsten trioxide and anomalous gold.

news.title: This unspoken tradition is stalling our economy. But is it really so bad?
news.snippet: This months-long pause isn’t carved into any legislation, but is an unofficial countrywide practice.
